en.topic_title: Hong Kong stock exchange posts record half-yearly profit

zh.topic_title: Hong Kong stock exchange posts record half-yearly profit

en.topic_title: Hong Kong stock exchange posts record half-yearly profit
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s stock exchange reported record profits on Wednesday, thanks to a surge in demand for initial public offerings by tech and artificial intelligence companies, the bourse operator said on Wednesday.



Exchange Square in Central, Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. 



The results come as Hong Kong’s IPO market saw a surge in listings from the artificial intelligence, technology and media and telecommunications sectors in the first half of 2026.
